reports.title: Lake Nacimiento held near 33 percent of its storage capacity
reports.text: One angler reported catching and releasing more than 100 bass and white bass using topwater lures, drop shots, and spoons. Crappie were readily available for anglers using mini jigs, swimbaits, and live minnows.

reports.title: Fishing was fair at Hart Park
reports.text: Fishing was fair at Hart Park, with anglers catching largemouth bass on Texas rigs, jigs, and weightless wacky-rigged Senkos in green pumpkin, brown, and black/purple colors.

reports.title: Fishing remained fair at BV
reports.text: Fishing remained fair at BV, with bass anglers reporting success using Texas rigs, Senkos, and jigs in green pumpkin, brown, and purple colors. Crappie anglers did well near the launch ramp using small live minnows and mini jigs.

reports.title: Crappie activity has been stronger later in the day
reports.text: Here at Ming Lake, bass have been feeding actively along the grass lines, with chatterbaits and spinnerbaits producing solid action. Crappie activity has been stronger later in the day, with minijigs and live shiners leading the bite.

reports.title: Bass fishing at River Walk continues to pick up
reports.text: Bass fishing at River Walk continues to pick up, with anglers finding the most consistent action during the early morning and late evening hours.

reports.title: Lake Isabella remained at 24 percent of capacity this week
reports.text: Lake Isabella remained at 24 percent of capacity this week, but bass fishing continues to be strong. Crappie fishing remains productive, although the bite has slowed and anglers are having to put in a little more effort to find fish. Red’s Marina and French Gulch continue to produce crappie on minijigs and small live shiners.

reports.title: Cooler temperatures and poor water conditions appeared to have finally stalled a months-long bite
reports.text: Both largemouth and smallmouth bass moved into the 15- to 30-foot zone, where finesse baits in Green Pumpkin black flake, Aaron’s Magic and Margarita Mutilator produced some action.
